inherit.use: Use the runtime's configured model and reasoning effort.

fast.use: Explicit low-effort opt-in for cheap, mechanical work; for direct runner use.

standard.use: Explicit medium reasoning for bounded tasks.

deep.use: High reasoning for complex logic, uncertain root causes or interacting components.

max.use: Max reasoning for the hardest bounded problems.

image.use: Opt in to Codex image generation and provenance checks.
